purpose: Measure local Codex task elapsed time, ambiguity-safe runtime model attribution, available compute, and aggregate asset presence without publishing message content, source identities, source paths, or input-file content hashes.

work_measurement.selected_records: Top-level JSON objects are parsed without depending on byte layout or whitespace. Only turn_context and selected event_msg payload fields affect measurement.
work_measurement.authoritative_interval: Each accepted task_complete defines exactly one half-open interval [completed_utc - normalized_duration, completed_utc). task_started timestamps do not alter that interval.
work_measurement.completion_endpoint: Use payload.completed_at when present; otherwise use the top-level event timestamp. A present but invalid completed_at is rejected rather than replaced by a fallback.
work_measurement.additive_task_elapsed: Sum the integer-microsecond lengths of unique, non-conflicting accepted completion intervals.
work_measurement.calendar_union_elapsed: Union the same accepted half-open intervals in integer microseconds. The union must be less than or equal to additive elapsed time.

duration_validation.rule: Reject missing, Boolean, negative, non-finite, NaN, and greater-than-seven-day duration_ms values.

work_measurement.model_identity: Attribute a completion only from non-reserved exact model strings in matching turn_context records observed before that completion. No context is __UNATTRIBUTED__; conflicting contexts or duplicate evidence are __AMBIGUOUS__; late contexts never backfill an earlier completion.
work_measurement.duplicate_completions: Identical completion intervals for one turn are counted once and reported as duplicates. Conflicting duplicate intervals are excluded from elapsed totals.
work_measurement.in_progress_tasks: A unique valid task_started turn with no observed valid completion or matching abort is pending. Pending tasks are reported separately and excluded from completed-task totals.
work_measurement.goal_snapshot: Optional caller-supplied numeric metadata. Objective text is prohibited and goal runtime is not added to completion totals.

source_validation.root: A missing, non-directory, unresolved, or symbolic-link session root is INVALID.
source_validation.source_files: Symbolic links and sources outside the resolved root are never read. Read, discovery, mutation, and parse failures are counted without source identity.
source_validation.mutation: A source must retain device, inode, size, and nanosecond modification time from pre-open through end-of-read and post-close validation. Mutated source measurements are discarded.
source_validation.quality: A fully readable and well-formed corpus is VALID. Partial or ambiguous evidence is DEGRADED. An invalid root or a discovered corpus with no usable source is INVALID.

privacy.noninterference: Changing ignored message, prompt, or tool-output payload content without changing selected provenance events does not change work measurement output.

compute_measurement.gpu_source: nvidia-smi plus the active Python runtime when available
compute_measurement.cuda_smoke_test: Optional bounded FP16 matrix multiplication. Throughput is a local engineering measurement, not a vendor benchmark.

asset_measurement.quant_lab: Count files and bytes both including and excluding dependency/cache directories. File count is not a simulation count.
asset_measurement.premium_mirror: Read only aggregate fields and byte size from the existing mirror summary.
asset_measurement.canonical_evidence: Report presence and byte size under protocol-defined artifact IDs; do not publish local paths, input-file hashes, or reinterpret scientific results.

packet_publication.archive: A complete ZIP packet containing receipt JSON, Markdown, and manifest is fsynced and atomically hard-linked into an immutable collision-protected archive name.
packet_publication.latest: Convenience latest files are atomically replaced only after archive publication; the latest-packet pointer is written last and is authoritative.
packet_publication.output_hash_boundary: Receipt and manifest hashes protect generated output packets. They are not hashes of session or other input files.

claim_boundaries: Elapsed agent-task time is engineering provenance, not scientific validation.
Token counts are workload metadata, not a valuation, bill, or measure of correctness.
Model attribution is exact only when event ordering is unambiguous; no model alias is inferred.
Model use does not transfer ownership of the underlying model or establish independent review.
Compute throughput does not establish production readiness, field validation, safety, profitability, or government approval.
File, row, exposure, model-call, trial, and independent-run counts are distinct and must not be merged.
Existing QuantLab and premium assets remain governed by their original protocols, receipts, and claim boundaries.
